title: First-time buyer just browsing listings
scenario: Young renter who has been scrolling listing apps calls in to understand the basics. She is clear she is only looking and not ready to buy this year.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Copperleaf Home Loans, this is Priya speaking, how can I help?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Hi, um, I'm Talia. I'm not really sure I'm calling the right place. I've just been looking at houses online.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: You're absolutely in the right place. Are you thinking about buying your first home?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Maybe? Like, eventually. I'm honestly just looking right now, I'm not ready to do anything.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: That's a perfect time to call, actually. No pressure here, we can just get you oriented.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Okay, cool, because I feel like I don't even know the words people use.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Ha, that's really common. Are you renting right now?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah, a one-bedroom. My lease is up next August.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Okay, so you've got some runway. And are you thinking you'd buy on your own?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah, just me. And my cat.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: The cat gets a vote, obviously. Do you have a sense of what area you're looking in?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Kind of the north side, near my job. Townhouses mostly.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Nice. Have you started saving anything toward a down payment?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: A little. Like eleven thousand-ish. Is that even enough to do anything with?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: It can be a real start. There are programs with smaller down payment requirements, and some first-time buyer assistance, but what fits depends on your income, your credit, and the property. That's exactly what a pre-qualification conversation would sort out.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Okay. I mean, I'm really just browsing for now, though.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Totally understood. Would it be helpful if I emailed you a short first-time buyer guide so you can read up at your own pace?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah, that'd actually be great.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: And maybe we check back in around spring, before your lease decision?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Spring works.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Perfect. I'll send that guide over today. Thanks for calling, Talia.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Thanks, Priya. Bye.
